# Anthony Dake — Drummer & Producer (Columbus, Ohio)

> Drummer and producer in Columbus, OH. Live shows, tours and fly dates, remote and in-room session drums, drum programming and production. ~405 documented performances and ~52 record credits since 2017. This file is the full content dump for LLM ingestion; see llms.txt for the short version.

---

## Who I am

Anthony Dake is a drummer and producer based in Columbus, Ohio. He sells exactly two offers:

- **Drummer** — live shows, tours, and fly dates; session drums remote or in your room. Click, IEM, acoustic and hybrid rigs.
- **Producer** — drum programming and production for records. Remote, fast, release-ready stems.

He has worked with Columbus-area independent artists across hip-hop, R&B, indie, and country adjacent genres. Frequent collaborators include KJ The Cool Nerd, Bitty (funk-soul), AR!YAH, WANYEH, Madelyn Leona, Smoothboi.Ty, KeezyTheeUnkind, EDwen, and Riyah.

## Services and rates

- Drummer: tour-ready live performance, festival mainstage, theater, club, church, corporate; session drums in-person (Columbus area) or remote with high-quality multi-track delivery.
- Producer: drum programming and production for records, delivered as release-ready stems.

Booking inquiries go through the in-site form at anthonydakemusic.com or via email at adakemusic@gmail.com. The press one-sheet PDF is at https://www.anthonydakemusic.com/Anthony_Dake_One-Sheet.pdf.

## Training and background

- **Blue Knights Drum Corps** — World Class DCI corps, summer tours 2017 and 2018.
- **Rhythm X** — Independent World WGI, 2020 season (COVID-shortened).
- **Shadow Drum & Bugle Corps** — DCI Open Class.
- **Dojo Percussion** — WGI Independent.
- High school: 4 years of marching band (every fall Friday + competitions), jazz ensemble, percussion ensemble.
- College: jazz band concerts, percussion ensemble concerts.
- Childhood through teens: 5+ years of weekly church drumming.

The /practice page on the site is a public, daily-updated practice journal — a transparent training log for anyone evaluating his current work ethic and growth.
